about: The closed list of words the descriptor of an export (a field for titles and search, not part of the name; docs/NAMING.md) may use, and the word each Lean connective is read as. Symbol words follow Mathlib's naming dictionary (https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/naming.html, 'Names of symbols' and 'Axiomatic descriptions'); PM's names are those of its 'Alphabetical list of propositions referred to by names' (pm_names.json), lowercased. A word is added here, with its meaning, before any descriptor uses it. scripts/export_names.py checks every descriptor against this list.

imp.meaning: implication ⊃ (Mathlib: → is 'of / imp'). Also PM's name Imp (✱3·31); in a name, PM's name comes right after the number and the connective after it

of.meaning: an asserted implication or a hypothesis, conclusion first: B_of_A is 'B, given A' (Mathlib: 'the conclusion is stated first')

all.meaning: the universal quantifier (x) . φx, also (x, y) (Mathlib: ∀ is 'all / forall')

exists.meaning: the existential quantifier (∃x) . φx, also (∃x, y)

unique.meaning: after exists: E! of a description, 'exactly one' (Mathlib: ∃! is ExistsUnique)

self.meaning: the same proposition on both sides of a connective, as in or_self

left.meaning: the left operand of the other side, as in And.left

right.meaning: the right operand of the other side, as in And.right

comm.meaning: the operands of a connective swapped (axiomatic name). Also PM's name Comm (✱2·04)

desc.meaning: a description (ιx)(φx) in a context (✱14·01); Mathlib has no word for it

cls.meaning: a class ẑ(φz) in a context, or 'is a class' (✱20·01, ✱20·03); Mathlib's word for {x | p x} is setOf, which is not lowercase

rel.meaning: a relation x̂ŷ φ(x, y) in a context, or x R y (✱21·01, ✱21·02)

subset.meaning: inclusion: α ⊂ β of classes (✱22·01), R ⪽ S of relations (✱23·01) (Mathlib: ⊆ is 'subset'; PM's ⊂ and ⪽ are not strict)

inter.meaning: logical product: α ∩ β of classes (✱22·02), R ∩̇ S of relations (✱23·02) (Mathlib: ∩ is 'inter')

union.meaning: logical sum: α ∪ β of classes (✱22·03), R ⊍ S of relations (✱23·03) (Mathlib: ∪ is 'union')

compl.meaning: negation: −α of a class (✱22·04), ∸R of a relation (✱23·04) (Mathlib: ᶜ is 'compl')

sdiff.meaning: difference: α − β = α ∩ −β of classes (✱22·05), R ∸ S = R ∩̇ ∸S of relations (✱23·05) (Mathlib: set difference is 'sdiff')

univ.meaning: the universal class V = x̂(x = x) (✱24·01), the universal relation V̇ = x̂ŷ(x = x . y = y) (✱25·01) (Mathlib: Set.univ is 'univ')

empty.meaning: the null-class Λ = −V (✱24·02), the null relation Λ̇ = ∸V̇ (✱25·02) (Mathlib: ∅ is 'empty')

nonempty.meaning: the existence of a class, ∃!α . = . (∃x) . x ∈ α (✱24·03), or of a relation, ∃̇!R . = . (∃x, y) . xRy (✱25·03), not E! of ✱14·02 (Mathlib: Set.Nonempty is 'nonempty')

prop.meaning: a bare proposition, used only when a statement has no connective to name (always needs review)

unknown.meaning: placeholder for a connective with no word yet; never allowed in a committed name

meta.meaning: a result about PM's system rather than one of its propositions (PM.meta_<words>)

sound.meaning: every theorem of ✱1's system is a tautology

complete.meaning: every tautology is a theorem of ✱1's system

variant.meaning: a variant of a printed proposition found in a transcription

thm.meaning: a theorem of the system (Mathlib abbreviates theorem as thm)
